notes.title: Patch Notes 09-09-2021
notes.content:
Hello players,

The latest patch for Soul Nomad & the World Eaters includes the following changes:

 The bugs that have been introduced after the previous achievement patches have been addressed
 Fixed issues with cursor movement when using the control pad


Thank you for your patience as we continue to improve your gaming experience.

notes.title: Patch Notes 09-03-2021
notes.content:
Hello players,

The latest patch for Soul Nomad & the World Eaters includes the following changes:

 Addressed crash at a specific event in-game (After clearing Map 32)
 Bugs related to achievements have been fixed
 Fixed issue with the cursor disappearing after right mouse button click
 Improved camera rotation controls with mouse 


Thank you for your patience as we continue to improve your gaming experience.
